sourceText: User request 2026-07-09: story B-cee5 shipped packages/main/src/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.ts (static guard preventing reviewer prompts from regressing to unconditional full decisions-directory scans), but wiring it into lattice validate required editing lattice.config.json, which was outside that story execution-boundary allowedPaths. Open a small follow-up Lattice story that adds one entry to lattice.config.json validate.commands: node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js (same pattern as retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js at line ~27). Note: run-all-smokes.js already auto-discovers the guard via directory scan, so an alternative is wiring run-all-smokes if the team prefers aggregate execution. Verify with lattice validate after wiring.
normalizedOutcome: lattice validate runs reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js as one of its validate.commands entries, so the guard shipped by B-cee5 is actually enforced on every validate run.
acceptanceClaim: A full lattice validate run in the B-04bb worktree, with B-cee5 landed on main and merged in, executes node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js and exits 0 overall.
